title: John Peterson's 1998 Arlington Institute meeting on extraterrestrials living among us

tellings.quote: we're doing a little get together uh of a mini conference to discuss what it's what it would be like in a world where extraterrestrials are openly acknowledged as living among us.

plain: In 1998, John Peterson's Arlington Institute held a small invitation-only meeting, a "mini conference to discuss what it would be like in a world where extraterrestrials are openly acknowledged as living among us." The researcher Richard Dolan tells Michels about it as he heard it from Katherine Austin Fitz and Peterson. If it is true, people were already planning in the 1990s for the day aliens living among us would become public.
